release: Thumbnail HTTP Admission Control & Demand Telemetry
name: Thumbnail HTTP Admission Control & Demand Telemetry
changes: Caps browser-side /api/thumbnail/image HTTP admission at five in-flight requests without reducing NNTP provider or preview concurrency.
Records thumbnail admission wait plus visible-versus-prefetch scheduler/HTTP timing so Diagnostics can separate user-visible demand from speculative work.
Normalizes superseded browsing-session preview/thumbnail cancellation as expected non-retryable control flow instead of allowing it to surface as a generic application error.
Preserves v3.6.62 progressive header reuse, v3.6.63/v3.6.64 name-resolution rendering behavior, 800-header bounds, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Discover and Automation behavior.
regression_guards: Browser image-thumbnail HTTP admission is a separate five-request gate and must not change provider connection allocation, preview ramp ceilings, video limits, or native decoder workers.
Visible and prefetch thumbnail demand remains priority ordered; speculative next-page image warming must pass through the same image HTTP admission gate.
Browsing telemetry schema 5 accepts thumbnail_admission while preserving request-paired thumbnail server/transport-gap telemetry and endpoint concurrency measurement.
Superseded BrowseSessionCancelled preview/image/video requests return browse_cancelled and do not render thumbnail errors; SAB 5.1.2 and terminal-history schema 3 remain unchanged.
release_name: Thumbnail HTTP Admission Control & Demand Telemetry
